trust_decision.summary: Messages that arrive on the shared Redis pub/sub channel are trusted as PHP-serialized objects and passed to unserialize() with no class allow-list, inside PusherPubSubIncomingMessageHandler::handle.

landing_point.why: This is the only file with unserialize() calls on Redis input, and the summary names Redis horizontal scaling; a grep for unserialize goes straight to it.

fix_sites.entry_point: Redis subscriber 'message' callback (RedisPubSubProvider::subscribe) -> handle(); the 'application' key of every pub/sub event type
Same Redis subscriber callback, 'metrics' event type, 'payload' key

O3_reason_to_dismiss: There is no route to dismiss. The two unserialize calls sit 13 lines apart in one function, and a grep shows them both.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Cross-node metrics gathering needs PendingMetric, its nested Application and the MetricType enum to deserialize from the 'metrics' payload. A fix that uses allowed_classes=false, allows only Application, or switches to JSON without a matching change on the producer side breaks multi-node channel and connection metrics. The 'message' and 'terminate' events also need Application.

O6_input_shapes: serialized PendingMetric with nested Application and MetricType enum in event['payload'] (metrics event)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Metric replies from other nodes (payload['payload']) could be sent as serialize()d arrays and unserialized in the listenForMetrics callback.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The request side already serializes the PendingMetric, so a maintainer could have made the reply symmetric. It would sit in a different function from the landing point.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The restart or reload signal could carry a serialized payload through Cache or Redis that the server unserializes on poll.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The reload command (b97d216) and the restart signal already pass state between processes through Cache, so a serialized-state variant would fit.

O9_family: insecure deserialization (CWE-502, PHP unserialize object injection on inter-node pub/sub messages)

O10_build.project_tests: tests/Unit/Servers/Reverb/Publishing/RedisPubSubProviderTest.php and tests/Unit/EventTest.php. Feature tests for Redis scaling exist but need a Redis server; handler-level unit tests can call PusherPubSubIncomingMessageHandler::handle() directly with no Redis.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add ['allowed_classes' => [Application::class]] to both calls. This breaks the metrics payload (PendingMetric/MetricType), or the engineer fixes only line 21.

out_of_scope_notes: StartServer polls Cache::get('laravel:reverb:restart') (src/Servers/Reverb/Console/Commands/StartServer.php:105); that unserialization happens in the Laravel cache framework, not in Reverb.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell). src/ has about 95 PHP files, so it is almost certainly under 5 MB; tiny_repo is inferred from that.
single_site: the fix changes two calls in one function, not literally one place. It is flagged because there is no O2 site or O8 route.
Whether the latest release changes the handler further was not checked (no latest tree given).
